ffmpeg_source_hint:
Which ffmpeg is used:

bundled: the ffmpeg.exe distributed with this app (shipped next to the executable and packaged inside it). This is the default and recommended choice.
path: the ffmpeg found in the system PATH.
custom: a specific ffmpeg.exe you pick.

If the selected ffmpeg cannot be found, the program falls back to PATH and prints a warning in the console.
mp4_bitrate_hint: Video quality: sets the MP4 video bitrate (kbps). Does not affect the webm output. Leave empty to use the ffmpeg default.
lossless_audio_hint: When enabled, the MP4 audio is kept lossless by copying the wav (ipcm/pcm) track directly instead of the webm's opus. Note: some players do not support ipcm tracks in MP4.
mp4_encoder_hint:
Encoder used for the MP4 output.

auto: tries GPU encoders first (h264_nvenc/h264_qsv/h264_amf/h264_mf), falls back to software encoders if unavailable.
h264_nvenc: NVIDIA GPU hardware encoder.
h264_qsv: Intel GPU hardware encoder (Quick Sync).
h264_amf: AMD GPU hardware encoder.
h264_mf: Windows built-in hardware encoder (Media Foundation).
libx264: CPU software encoder, best compatibility, slowest.
libsvtav1: CPU software AV1 encoder, better quality at lower bitrates but slower.
subtitles_mode_hint:
burn: subtitles are permanently merged into the video frames (MP4 output only), style settings apply.
stream: subtitles are embedded as a separate soft subtitle track (MP4 output only), plain text without styling; most players require enabling subtitles manually.
